Набір містить дані про рейси громадського транспорту Синельниківської міської ради. Coverage: Синельниківська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Синельниківська міська рада. Its keywords include автобус, відбуття, графік, маршрут, перевізники, прибуття. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-08-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
